criteria: Victims and survivors of sexual assault and offenses registered under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act.
exclusions: Civil and general property disputes.

documents: Police Charge Sheet / POCSO Case Registration Records.

schemes.scheme_name: Free Legal Aid & Lok Adalat Services (NALSA)

jurisdiction.ministry: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)

description.overview: Provides free competent legal services to the weaker sections of society and organizes Lok Adalats for amicable dispute settlement.
description.benefits: Free lawyer engagement, exemption from court fees, free process fees, certified copy charges, and free preparation of appeal briefs.

criteria: Women, children, members of SC/ST, industrial workmen, disabled persons, persons in custody, and individuals with annual income ≤ ₹3 Lakh.
exclusions: Defamation, election disputes, and cases punishable with fine only.

jurisdiction.ministry: Ministry Of Law and Justice

description.overview: Establishes village-level courts at the headquarters of every intermediate Panchayat to provide speedy and affordable justice.
description.benefits: Affordable local justice, informal conciliation procedures, zero court fees for marginalized sections, and swift resolution within 6 months.

criteria: All rural citizens residing in the jurisdiction of notified Gram Nyayalayas filing civil disputes or petty criminal offenses.
exclusions: Serious criminal offenses with imprisonment exceeding 2 years
